name: trackr
description: Ask about your Trackr UGC campaigns, creators, posts and analytics, and make changes after a preview.

interface.longDescription:
Trackr (UGCTrackr) is where brands and agencies run their user-generated content programs on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. This plugin lets you ask about your Trackr workspace in plain language: which campaigns are running, how a campaign is performing, which posts and creators are driving views, what commenters are saying, and how to do something in Trackr.

It can also make changes for you, such as updating campaign goals and settings, adding playbook concepts, editing creators' details, pausing accounts and setting up post alerts. Trackr asks ChatGPT to show you a preview of each change and confirm with you before applying it. It can't delete campaigns, creators or posts, and it can't pay anyone.

Access is scoped to one Trackr team you choose when you connect. Client workspaces and creator accounts are read-only. You can revoke the connection at any time from Trackr.
capabilities: Summarize campaign views, posts and engagement
Find top posts and creators, with TikTok and Instagram post insights
Summarize comment sentiment on tracked posts
Update campaign goals, settings, post alerts and playbook concepts, after a preview
Edit creators, invite them to the portal, pause accounts and send contracts, after a preview
Answer how-to questions from the Trackr docs
defaultPrompt: Which of my Trackr campaigns are active right now?
What were my top 5 posts by views this week?
Which creators drove the most views last month?

positive.description: List the team's campaigns and their status
positive.prompt: Which of my Trackr campaigns are active right now, and when did they start?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected team's campaigns, identifying the active one(s) (on the review account: Acme, started 2026-05-25) with start dates. Inactive campaigns are labelled as inactive or omitted.

positive.prompt: How is the Acme campaign doing in Trackr? Give me total views, number of posts and engagement.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Acme campaign, then returns its summary totals (views, posts, likes/engagement) from Trackr without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: Show me the top 5 posts by views in the Acme campaign with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five Acme posts ordered by views, each with its view count, creator and a link to the post.

positive.prompt: Which creators posted in the Acme campaign, and who has the most views?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists creators on the Acme campaign with their post and view totals, highlighting the top creator by views.

positive.description: How-to question answered from Trackr docs
positive.prompt: How do I stop collecting new posts from one creator's account in a Trackr campaign without removing it?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Trackr documentation and explains Pause collection: Edit campaign, the creator's handle menu, Pause collection (Resume collection turns it back on), citing the Campaigns docs page.

positive.description: Preview marking a creator inactive (write tool, preview only)
positive.prompt: In Trackr, preview marking the creator Kevin on the Acme campaign as inactive. Show me the preview only, don't apply it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls deactivate_creators without apply and shows the preview: Kevin and the two TikTok accounts that would go inactive. Nothing changes. ChatGPT asks before applying anything.

positive.description: Preview editing a creator's details (write tool, preview only)
positive.prompt: In Trackr, preview changing the creator Kevin's country to Canada. Show me the preview only, don't apply it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls update_creators without apply and shows Kevin's country before and after. Nothing changes. ChatGPT asks before applying anything.

negative.description: Delete request: the plugin has no delete tools
negative.prompt: Delete the Acme campaign from Trackr.

negative.description: Publishing request: the plugin can't post videos to social accounts
negative.prompt: Post a new TikTok video from @playkit.xyz with the caption 'New drop!'

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in San Francisco today?

publication.release_notes: Trackr can now make changes for you, each shown as a preview and confirmed before it applies: campaign goals and settings, post alerts, playbook concepts, creators' details and portal invites, pausing accounts, Client HQ links, Spark code requests and contracts. Post details now include TikTok and Instagram insights.
